details: d to e: Yes Sir, development of an online portal for the Cooperative Ombudsman has been initiated for transparent, efficient and technology driven management of complaints and appeals.

records.title: SCHEMES FOR FINANCIAL INCLUSION OF WOMEN.
details: a to c: i) As per para 32 of Union Budget 2025-26 " A new scheme will be launched for 5 lakh women, Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes first- time entrepreneurs. This will provide term loans upto Rs. 2.00 Crore during next 5 years. The Scheme will incorporate lesson from successful Stand Up India Scheme. Online capacity building for entrepreneurship and managerial skills will also be organized"

details: चूंकि प्रश्न संदर्भित प्रश्न है। सम्माननीय सदस्य ने जो प्रश्न पूछा है, वह कहीं संबद्ध नहीं है। यह उनका सुझाव है। मैंने उनका सुझाव लिखकर रखा है और उस पर उचित कार्रवाई की जा सकती है।
